findings.title: Alias actions are not distinguished by their expected dialog outcomes

support.quote: button: 'Keep alias',

findings.failure: Returning the expire dialog for schedule, keep, and reactivate would pass: every description still contains @old. The suite therefore does not protect the distinct action presented for confirmation.
findings.correction: Use explicit expected titles, buttons, and distinguishing description content for each action.

findings.title: Polling and owner clearing share an unrelated test

test.quote: it('pauses import polling during writes and purges only resolved session transitions', () => {

support.quote: export { pictureSelection, pictureImportPollInterval, shouldClearOwnerProfile } from './pictures';

findings.failure: A polling assertion failure prevents the owner-transition checks from running, coupling diagnosis of two independently exported policies.
findings.correction: Give polling intervals and owner clearing separate tests.

findings.title: HMAC compatibility lacks an independent successful fixture

support.quote: crypto.createHmac('sha256', config.secret).update(payload).digest('hex');

findings.failure: Encode and decode could both use a different key-dependent 64-character signing calculation and still pass. Independently signed fixtures are only expected to fail, so they do not establish compatibility with valid HMAC-SHA256 cursors.
findings.correction: Decode a valid cursor constructed by the independent signing helper, and verify an encoded signature against an independently calculated HMAC.

findings.title: Blank-input rejection and port isolation are untested

support.quote: Blank input returns Invalid and never calls write.

findings.failure: An implementation that writes an empty trimmed value and returns Saved for blank input passes the supplied test.
findings.correction: Add a blank-input case asserting Invalid and an empty write-call record.

findings.title: Pending interval is compared with itself

support.quote: Pending and retrying poll at 5000ms unless writing.

findings.failure: Any deterministic incorrect interval for idle pending status passes because production supplies both actual and expected values.
findings.correction: Assert the independently specified value 5000 directly.

findings.title: Editor test asserts private storage instead of public value

support.quote: Editor.set updates the public value property. Private storage representation may change without breaking clients.

findings.failure: Renaming storage breaks this test despite preserved client behavior, while a broken public getter can pass.
findings.correction: Assert editor.value after calling set.

findings.title: Opaque scenario names hide polling inputs and outcomes

support.quote: const [status,writing,expected]=cases[scenario]; assert.equal(poll(status,writing),expected);

findings.failure: The caller cannot explain which status, write state, or expected interval each scenario checks without opening the helper's lookup table.
findings.correction: Declare explicit status, writing, and expected tuples at the caller and pass them to the helper.

findings.title: Independent polling and ownership policies share one test

support.quote: Polling and session ownership are independent policies.

findings.failure: A polling failure stops all ownership assertions, making ownership verification depend on an unrelated policy passing.
findings.correction: Split the polling and session-ownership assertions into separately named tests.

findings.title: Identity wrapper repeats the complete polling matrix

support.quote: A higher-level identity wrapper adds no translation, synchronization or browser risk.

findings.failure: Every policy change produces duplicate test failures and maintenance at a boundary that exercises no additional behavior.
findings.correction: Keep the complete matrix at poll's public boundary and remove its repetition through screen.poll.

findings.title: Optional: flatten the hierarchy around one interval assertion

support.quote: Nesting and snapshot size are optional advisory observations only; no numerical limit is repository policy.

findings.failure: Understanding this single scenario requires assembling its meaning across four suite labels and the generic test name 'is fixed'; the hierarchy supplies no shared setup.
findings.correction: Optionally replace the hierarchy with one descriptive test such as 'pending polls every 5000ms while idle'.
